events.title: Book Fair in the Park
events.description:
at

Join us for a cozy, book filled day at Book Fair in the Park! Shop a variety of books from local bookstores before diving into your new read and relaxing in the shade! Bring a gently used book to trade for a new-to-you read at the free Book Swap! Plus, we’ll have yard games and more set out to enjoy!

Featuring:
Good Riches Books
The Book Fairy
Perasma Book Co.
Kurt Vonnegut Museum and Library
Indiana Humanities
Books + Indy
Little Cup Matcha Cart
The Stacks Mobile Bookshop

What to Expect:
Local bookstores
Local book focused nonprofits
Sweet treats
Live music by Chad Hollister (3-5pm)
Free book swap
Yard games

Event is FREE to attend! Vendors may have additional costs.

RSVP to tell us you’re coming!
Book Fair in the Park is FREE to attend. Registration is not required, but is encouraged to help us plan!

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is the event located?
Book Fair in the Park will take place in Military Park.

Where should I park?
Paid parking is available in the White River State Park underground parking garage located in front of the Indiana State Museum. Military Park is located within walking distance to several other parking lots and garages.

What is a book swap?
A book swap is a way to pass along a book you no longer want and take home a different book for free. Bring one (or more!) gently used books and take home a new-to-you book! Please only bring books in good condition. If you wouldn’t be willing to give it to a friend, don’t bring it to the swap.

Will there be food or drinks?
Little Cup Matcha Cart will have drinks available for purchase. Guests are welcome to bring their own food and non-alcoholic beverages.

events.title: Apocalypse Now Final Cut: The IMAX Experience
events.description:
at

IMAX | R | 183min | Action

IMAX Indy Revivals: Apocalypse Now Final Cut
A film by Francis Ford Coppola
Original release date: August 15, 1979
Presented in IMAX with Laser

Part of IMAX Indy’s continuing celebration of great film experiences, old and new.

Francis Ford Coppola’s stunning vision of “The Heart of Darkness” in all of us remains a classic and compelling Vietnam War epic. Martin Sheen stars as Army Captain Willard, a troubled man sent on a dangerous and mesmerizing odyssey into Cambodia to assassinate a renegade American colonel named Kurtz (Marlon Brando), who has succumbed to the horrors of war and barricaded himself in a remote outpost.

The IMAX release of Apocalypse Now Final Cut will be digitally re-mastered into the image and sound quality The IMAX Experience® with proprietary IMAX DMR® (Digital Re-mastering) technology. The crystal-clear images, coupled with IMAX’s customized theatre geometry and powerful digital audio, create a unique environment that will make audiences feel as if they are in the movie.

events.title: Heroes from the Heartland
events.description:
at

Veterans and their families are invited to join the Indiana State Museum as we honor Hoosier veterans who have selflessly served and continue to serve our country. Learn about the state’s military history with a visit to the Heroes from the Heartland display and take a moment to see artifacts from the collection that share important stories. Meet with the museum’s curator of history to ask questions and explore hands-on activities and resources from community partners.

Be sure to stay for the Indianapolis Municipal Band Veteran’s Day Concert starting at 3 p.m.!

As a way to thank service members, the museum is proud to offer active and veteran military free admission, and their immediate family members will receive a $2 discount on each admission pass. Free parking will be available in the White River State Park garage on a first-come, first-served basis for veterans or active military with proof of ID.

events.title: FREE ADMISSION – Martin Luther King Jr. Day
events.description:
at

FREE White River State Park attraction admission on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, January 19th!

White River State Park attractions are offering FREE admission and an opportunity to donate to Gleaners Food Bank of Indiana on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, January 18, 2027.

For over 20 years, White River State Park and Gleaners have partnered on this one-day, annual event, raising money and building awareness for Gleaners’ fight against hunger in central Indiana. 1 in 7 Hoosiers are facing hunger. For every $1 donated, Gleaners Food Bank of Indiana can provide 6 meals for neighbors in need. $20 can provide 120 meals!

Park visitors are encouraged to donate money to Gleaners at donation stations located throughout the park at each attraction. Donations will also be accepted online leading up to and during the event.

The following attractions will have free admission on January 18:
● Eiteljorg Museum of American Indians and Western Art
● IMAX Theater
● Indiana State Museum
● Indianapolis Zoo
● NCAA Hall of Champions

The park is also offering complimentary parking on MLK Day. Visitors may park in the underground garage located off Washington Street in front of the Indiana State Museum and in the surface parking lot next to the Park’s Visitor’s Center. Parking is not guaranteed and is on a first-come, first-served basis.

About Gleaners Food Bank of Indiana, Inc.
Gleaners was founded in 1980 and is a respected leader within Feeding America, the nation’s food bank network. Since that time, Gleaners has distributed more than 800 million pounds of food and critical grocery products through nearly 250 hunger relief agencies, schools and community partners serving needy Hoosiers. In addition to food distribution to agencies, we serve our most vulnerable populations, seniors and children, through specialty programs such as Gleaners2Go, Home Delivery, School-Based Pantries, Mobile Pantries, Summer Meals for Kids, and Senior Hunger Initiative programs. Charity Navigator has recognized Gleaners as a 4-Star organization, the highest rating for charity demonstrating fiscal management and accountability. In addition, Gleaners is an accredited charity with the Better Business Bureau and has earned a Platinum Seal of Transparency from GuideStar. To learn more, visit www.gleaners.org.
